question: FAISS IVF-PQ 在 N=10k 规模下，默认 nprobe=10 时的 Top-5 召回率（Recall@5）通常低于 Flat 索引的 99%+，具体数值约为 85%-92%（取决于 PQ 压缩损失），导致为了达到同等召回率必须将 nprobe 提升至 50-100，从而使检索延迟从 ~1ms 升至 5-15ms，抵消了构建时间的微小优势。

sources.title: Indexing 1G vectors · facebookresearch/faiss Wiki · GitHub
sources.snippet: This means that by setting the parameters nprobe=128,quantizer_efSearch=32 with the ParameterSpace object, we obtain 0.6786 recall@1 for that dataset, the search will take 0.05387 ms per query. The total number of distances computed for the 10k queries is 142670158 and this measurement was obtained in 6 runs (to reduce jitter in time measurements).
